member.name: P:QuantConnect.AlgorithmSettings.StalePriceTimeSpan
member.summary: Gets/sets the minimum time span elapsed to consider a market fill price as stale (defaults to one hour)
member.remarks: In the default fill models, a market order on an hour or daily resolution subscription is not filled on data older than this time span; instead it waits for fresh data (e.g. the next bar), avoiding a fill at the stale previous close. Market orders on minute/second/tick subscriptions still fill on stale data, only adding a warning message. Tighten it (e.g. to one minute) to make hour/daily orders wait for the next bar more aggressively.

member.name: T:QuantConnect.Api.LiveAlgorithmApiSettingsWrapper
member.summary: Helper class to put BaseLiveAlgorithmSettings in proper format.
Constructor for LiveAlgorithmApiSettingsWrapper
member.param: Id of compilation of project from QuantConnect
Server type to run live Algorithm

Dictionary with brokerage specific settings. Each brokerage requires certain specific credentials in order to process the given orders. Each key in this dictionary represents a required field/credential to provide to the brokerage API and its value represents the value of that field. For example: "brokerageSettings: { "id": "Binance", "binance-api-secret": "123ABC", "binance-api-key": "ABC123"}. It is worth saying, that this dictionary must always contain an entry whose key is "id" and its value is the name of the brokerage (see )

Dictionary with data providers credentials. Each data provider requires certain credentials in order to retrieve data from their API. Each key in this dictionary describes a data provider name and its corresponding value is another dictionary with the required key-value pairs of credential names and values. For example: "dataProviders: {InteractiveBrokersBrokerage : { "id": 12345, "environement" : "paper", "username": "testUsername", "password": "testPassword"}}"
Dictionary to specify the parameters for the live algorithm
Dictionary with the lists of events and targets

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Currencies._stableCoinsWithoutPairsCoinbase
member.summary:
Define some StableCoins that don't have direct pairs for base currencies in our SPDB in Coinbase market This is because some CryptoExchanges do not define direct pairs with the stablecoins they offer.
We use this to allow setting cash amounts for these stablecoins without needing a conversion security.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Currencies._stableCoinsWithoutPairsBinance
member.summary:
Define some StableCoins that don't have direct pairs for base currencies in our SPDB in Binance market This is because some CryptoExchanges do not define direct pairs with the stablecoins they offer.
We use this to allow setting cash amounts for these stablecoins without needing a conversion security.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Currencies._stableCoinsWithoutPairsBitfinex

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Currencies._stableCoinsWithoutPairsBybit

We use this to allow setting cash amounts for these stablecoins without needing a conversion security.

member.name: M:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.CorporateFactorProvider.HasDividendEventOnNextTradingDay(System.DateTime,System.Decimal@,System.Decimal@)
member.summary: Returns true if the specified date is the last trading day before a dividend event is to be fired
member.remarks: NOTE: The dividend event in the algorithm should be fired at the end or AFTER this date. This is the date in the file that a factor is applied, so for example, MSFT has a 31 cent dividend on 2015.02.17, but in the factor file the factor is applied to 2015.02.13, which is the first trading day BEFORE the actual effective date.
member.param: The date to check the factor file for a dividend event
When this function returns true, this value will be populated with the price factor ratio required to scale the closing value (pf_i/pf_i+1)
When this function returns true, this value will be populated with the reference raw price, which is the close of the provided date

member.name: M:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.CorporateFactorProvider.HasSplitEventOnNextTradingDay(System.DateTime,System.Decimal@,System.Decimal@)
member.summary: Returns true if the specified date is the last trading day before a split event is to be fired
member.remarks: NOTE: The split event in the algorithm should be fired at the end or AFTER this date. This is the date in the file that a factor is applied, so for example MSFT has a split on 1999.03.29, but in the factor file the split factor is applied on 1999.03.26, which is the first trading day BEFORE the actual split date.
member.param: The date to check the factor file for a split event
When this function returns true, this value will be populated with the split factor ratio required to scale the closing value
When this function returns true, this value will be populated with the reference raw price, which is the close of the provided date

member.name: T:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags
member.summary: Flag system for quote conditions

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.None
member.summary: No Condition

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.Regular
member.summary: This condition is used for the majority of quotes to indicate a normal trading environment.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.Slow
member.summary: This condition is used to indicate that the quote is a Slow Quote on both the Bid and Offer sides due to a Set Slow List that includes High Price securities.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.Gap
member.summary: While in this mode, auto-execution is not eligible, the quote is then considered manual and non-firm in the Bid and Offer and either or both sides can be traded through as per Regulation NMS.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.Closing
member.summary: This condition can be disseminated to indicate that this quote was the last quote for a security for that Participant.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.NewsDissemination
member.summary: This regulatory Opening Delay or Trading Halt is used when relevant news influencing the security is being disseminated. Trading is suspended until the primary market determines that an adequate publication or disclosure of information has occurred.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.NewsPending
member.summary: This condition is used to indicate a regulatory Opening Delay or Trading Halt due to an expected news announcement, which may influence the security. An Opening Delay or Trading Halt may be continued once the news has been disseminated.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.TradingRangeIndication
member.summary: The condition is used to denote the probable trading range (bid and offer prices, no sizes) of a security that is not Opening Delayed or Trading Halted. The Trading Range Indication is used prior to or after the opening of a security.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.OrderImbalance
member.summary: This non-regulatory Opening Delay or Trading Halt is used when there is a significant imbalance of buy or sell orders.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.ClosedMarketMaker
member.summary: This condition is disseminated by each individual FINRA Market Maker to signify either the last quote of the day or the premature close of an individual Market Maker for the day.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.VolatilityTradingPause
member.summary: This quote condition indicates a regulatory Opening Delay or Trading Halt due to conditions in which a security experiences a 10 % or more change in price over a five minute period.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.NonFirmQuote
member.summary: This quote condition suspends a Participant's firm quote obligation for a quote for a security.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.OpeningQuote
member.summary: This condition can be disseminated to indicate that this quote was the opening quote for a security for that Participant.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.DueToRelatedSecurity
member.summary: This non-regulatory Opening Delay or Trading Halt is used when events relating to one security will affect the price and performance of another related security. This non-regulatory Opening Delay or Trading Halt is also used when non-regulatory halt reasons such as Order Imbalance, Order Influx and Equipment Changeover are combined with Due to Related Security on CTS.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.Resume
member.summary: This quote condition along with zero-filled bid, offer and size fields is used to indicate that trading for a Participant is no longer suspended in a security which had been Opening Delayed or Trading Halted.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.InViewOfCommon
member.summary: This quote condition is used when matters affecting the common stock of a company affect the performance of the non-common associated securities, e.g., warrants, rights, preferred, classes, etc.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.EquipmentChangeover
member.summary: This non-regulatory Opening Delay or Trading Halt is used when the ability to trade a security by a Participant is temporarily inhibited due to a systems, equipment or communications facility problem or for other technical reasons.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.SubPennyTrading
member.summary: This non-regulatory Opening Delay or Trading Halt is used to indicate an Opening Delay or Trading Halt for a security whose price may fall below $1.05, possibly leading to a sub-penny execution.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.NoOpenNoResume
member.summary: This quote condition is used to indicate that an Opening Delay or a Trading Halt is to be in effect for the rest of the trading day in a security for a Participant.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.LimitUpLimitDownPriceBand
member.summary: This quote condition is used to indicate that a Limit Up-Limit Down Price Band is applicable for a security.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.RepublishedLimitUpLimitDownPriceBand
member.summary: This quote condition is used to indicate that a Limit Up-Limit Down Price Band that is being disseminated " + is a ‘republication’ of the latest Price Band for a security.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.Manual
member.summary: This indicates that the market participant is in a manual mode on both the Bid and Ask. While in this mode, automated execution is not eligible on the Bid and Ask side and can be traded through pursuant to Regulation NMS requirements.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.FastTrading
member.summary: For extremely active periods of short duration. While in this mode, the UTP participant will enter quotations on a “best efforts” basis.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.QuoteConditionFlags.OrderInflux
member.summary: A halt condition used when there is a sudden order influx. To prevent a disorderly market, trading is temporarily suspended by the UTP participant.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.None
member.summary: No Condition

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.Regular
member.summary: A trade made without stated conditions is deemed regular way for settlement on the third business day following the transaction date.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.Cash
member.summary: A transaction which requires delivery of securities and payment on the same day the trade takes place.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.NextDay
member.summary: A transaction that requires the delivery of securities on the first business day following the trade date.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.Seller
member.summary: A Seller’s Option transaction gives the seller the right to deliver the security at any time within a specific period, ranging from not less than two calendar days, to not more than sixty calendar days.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.YellowFlag
member.summary: Market Centers will have the ability to identify regular trades being reported during specific events as out of the ordinary by appending a new sale condition code Yellow Flag (Y) on each transaction reported to the UTP SIP. The new sale condition will be eligible to update all market center and consolidated statistics.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.IntermarketSweep
member.summary: The transaction that constituted the trade-through was the execution of an order identified as an Intermarket Sweep Order.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.OpeningPrints
member.summary: The trade that constituted the trade-through was a single priced opening transaction by the Market Center.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.ClosingPrints
member.summary: The transaction that constituted the trade-through was a single priced closing transaction by the Market Center.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.ReOpeningPrints
member.summary: The trade that constituted the trade-through was a single priced reopening transaction by the Market Center.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.DerivativelyPriced
member.summary: The transaction that constituted the trade-through was the execution of an order at a price that was not based, directly or indirectly, on the quoted price of the security at the time of execution and for which the material terms were not reasonably determinable at the time the commitment to execute the order was made.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.FormT
member.summary: Trading in extended hours enables investors to react quickly to events that typically occur outside regular market hours, such as earnings reports. However, liquidity may be constrained during such Form T trading, resulting in wide bid-ask spreads.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.Sold
member.summary: Sold Last is used when a trade prints in sequence but is reported late or printed in conformance to the One or Two Point Rule.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.Stopped
member.summary: The transaction that constituted the trade-through was the execution by a trading center of an order for which, at the time of receipt of the order, the execution at no worse than a specified price a 'stopped order'

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.ExtendedHours
member.summary: Identifies a trade that was executed outside of regular primary market hours and is reported as an extended hours trade.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.OutOfSequence
member.summary: Identifies a trade that takes place outside of regular market hours.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.Split
member.summary: An execution in two markets when the specialist or Market Maker in the market first receiving the order agrees to execute a portion of it at whatever price is realized in another market to which the balance of the order is forwarded for execution.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.Acquisition
member.summary: A transaction made on the Exchange as a result of an Exchange acquisition.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.Bunched
member.summary: A trade representing an aggregate of two or more regular trades in a security occurring at the same price either simultaneously or within the same 60-second period, with no individual trade exceeding 10,000 shares.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.StockOption
member.summary: Stock-Option Trade is used to identify cash equity transactions which are related to options transactions and therefore potentially subject to cancellation if market conditions of the options leg(s) prevent the execution of the stock-option order at the price agreed upon.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.Distribution
member.summary: Sale of a large block of stock in such a manner that the price is not adversely affected.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.AveragePrice
member.summary: A trade where the price reported is based upon an average of the prices for transactions in a security during all or any portion of the trading day.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.Cross
member.summary: Indicates that the trade resulted from a Market Center’s crossing session.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Auxiliary.TradeConditionFlags.PriceVariation
member.summary: Indicates a regular market session trade transaction that carries a price that is significantly away from the prevailing consolidated or primary market value at the time of the transaction.

member.name: T:QuantConnect.Data.Consolidators.ClassicRangeConsolidator
member.summary: This consolidator can transform a stream of instances into a stream of . The difference between this consolidator and , is that this last one creates intermediate/ phantom RangeBar's (RangeBar's with zero volume) if the price rises up or falls down by above/below two times the range size. Therefore, leaves no space between two adyacent RangeBar's since it always start a new RangeBar one range above the last RangeBar's High value or one range below the last RangeBar's Low value, where one range equals to one minimum price change.

member.summary: Trade Weighted US Dollar Index

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Custom.Intrinio.IntrinioEconomicDataSources.TradeWeightedUsDollarIndex.Broad
member.summary: A weighted average of the foreign exchange value of the U.S. dollar against the currencies of a broad group of major U.S. trading partners. Broad currency index includes the Euro Area, Canada, Japan, Mexico, China, United Kingdom, Taiwan, Korea, Singapore, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Brazil, Switzerland, Thailand, Philippines, Australia, Indonesia, India, Israel, Saudi Arabia, Russia, Sweden, Argentina, Venezuela, Chile and Colombia.
member.remarks: Source: https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/DTWEXB For more information about trade-weighted indexes see http://www.federalreserve.gov/pubs/bulletin/2005/winter05_index.pdf.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Custom.Intrinio.IntrinioEconomicDataSources.TradeWeightedUsDollarIndex.MajorCurrencies
member.summary: A weighted average of the foreign exchange value of the U.S. dollar against a subset of the broad index currencies that circulate widely outside the country of issue. Major currencies index includes the Euro Area, Canada, Japan, United Kingdom, Switzerland, Australia, and Sweden.
member.remarks: Source: https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/DTWEXM For more information about trade-weighted indexes see http://www.federalreserve.gov/pubs/bulletin/2005/winter05_index.pdf.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Custom.Intrinio.IntrinioEconomicDataSources.TradeWeightedUsDollarIndex.OtherImportantTradingPartners
member.summary: A weighted average of the foreign exchange value of the U.S. dollar against a subset of the broad index currencies that do not circulate widely outside the country of issue. Countries whose currencies are included in the other important trading partners index are Mexico, China, Taiwan, Korea, Singapore, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Brazil, Thailand, Philippines, Indonesia, India, Israel, Saudi Arabia, Russia, Argentina, Venezuela, Chile and Colombia.
member.remarks: Source: https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/DTWEXO For more information about trade-weighted indexes see http://www.federalreserve.gov/pubs/bulletin/2005/winter05_index.pdf.

member.param: true if we're in live mode, false for backtesting mode
member.returns: String URL of source file.
member.remarks: Given Intrinio's API limits, we cannot make more than one CSV request per second. That's why in backtesting mode we make sure we make just one call to retrieve all the data needed. member.name: T:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.StockType
member.summary: Helper class for the AssetClassification's StockType field

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.StockType.AggressiveGrowth
member.summary: Companies whose revenues and earnings have both been growing significantly faster than the general economy.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.StockType.ClassicGrowth
member.summary: Companies that are growing respectably faster than the general economy, and often pay a steady dividend. They tend to be mature and solidly profitable businesses.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.StockType.Cyclicals
member.summary: Companies in the cyclicals and durables sectors, except those in the three types below. The profits of cyclicals tend to rise and fall with the general economy.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.StockType.Distressed
member.summary: Companies that have had consistently declining cash flows and earnings over the past three years, and/or very high debt.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.StockType.HardAsset
member.summary: Companies that deal in assets such as oil, metals, and real estate, which tend to do well in inflationary environments.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.StockType.HighYield
member.summary: Companies that have dividend yields at least twice the average for large-cap stocks. They tend to be mature, slow-growing companies.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.StockType.SlowGrowth
member.summary: Companies that have shown slow revenue and earnings growth (typically less than the rate of GDP growth) over at least three years.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.StockType.SpeculativeGrowth
member.summary: Companies that have shown strong revenue growth but slower or spotty earnings growth. Very small or young companies also tend to fall into this class.

member.name: T:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.StyleBox
member.summary: Helper class for the AssetClassification's StyleBox field . For stocks and stock funds, it classifies securities according to market capitalization and growth and value factor

member.name: T:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarEconomySphereCode
member.summary: Helper class for the AssetClassification's MorningstarEconomySphereCode field .

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarEconomySphereCode.Cyclical
member.summary: The cyclical Super Sector includes industries significantly affected by economic shifts. When the economy is prosperous, these industries tend to expand, and when the economy is in a downturn they tend to shrink. In general, the stocks in these industries have betas of greater than 1.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarEconomySphereCode.Defensive
member.summary: The defensive Super Sector includes industries that are relatively immune to economic cycles. These industries provide services that consumers require in both good and bad times, such as healthcare and utilities. In general, the stocks in these industries have betas of less than 1.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarEconomySphereCode.Sensitive
member.summary: The sensitive Super Sector includes industries that ebb and flow with the overall economy, but not severely. Sensitive industries fall between defensive and cyclical, as they are not immune to a poor economy, but they also may not be as severely affected as industries in the cyclical Super Sector. In general, the stocks in these industries have betas that are close to 1.

member.name: T:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarSectorCode
member.summary: Helper class for the AssetClassification's MorningstarSectorCode field .

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarSectorCode.BasicMaterials
member.summary: Companies that manufacture chemicals, building materials, and paper products. This sector also includes companies engaged in commodities exploration and processing.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarSectorCode.ConsumerCyclical
member.summary: This sector includes retail stores, auto and auto-parts manufacturers, restaurants, lodging facilities, specialty retail and travel companies.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarSectorCode.FinancialServices
member.summary: Companies that provide financial services include banks, savings and loans, asset management companies, credit services, investment brokerage firms, and insurance companies.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarSectorCode.RealEstate
member.summary: This sector includes companies that develop, acquire, manage, and operate real estate properties.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarSectorCode.ConsumerDefensive
member.summary: Companies that manufacture food, beverages, household and personal products, packaging, or tobacco. Also includes companies that provide services such as education and training services.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarSectorCode.Healthcare
member.summary: This sector includes biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, research services, home healthcare, hospitals, long-term-care facilities, and medical equipment and supplies. Also include pharmaceutical retailers and companies which provide health information services.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarSectorCode.Utilities
member.summary: Electric, gas, and water utilities.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarSectorCode.CommunicationServices
member.summary: Companies that provide communication services using fixed-line networks or those that provide wireless access and services. Also includes companies that provide advertising & marketing services, entertainment content and services, as well as interactive media and content provider over internet or through software.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarSectorCode.Energy
member.summary: Companies that produce or refine oil and gas, oilfield-services and equipment companies, and pipeline operators. This sector also includes companies that mine thermal coal and uranium.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarSectorCode.Industrials
member.summary: Companies that manufacture machinery, hand-held tools, and industrial products. This sector also includes aerospace and defense firms as well as companies engaged in transportation services.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarSectorCode.Technology
member.summary: Companies engaged in the design, development, and support of computer operating systems and applications. This sector also includes companies that make computer equipment, data storage products, networking products, semiconductors, and components.

member.name: T:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryGroupCode
member.summary: Helper class for the AssetClassification's MorningstarIndustryGroupCode field .

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.AgriculturalInputs
member.summary: Companies that manufacture nitrogenous and phosphatic fertilizers, pesticides, seed, and other agricultural chemical products.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.BuildingMaterials
member.summary: Companies that manufacture construction materials, including stone, clay, and brick products, cement, lime, gypsum, and concrete and other construction products. Excludes companies that manufacture finished and semi finished building products.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.Chemicals
member.summary: Chemical manufacturing companies engaged in diverse chemical and chemical-related operations, and basic chemicals manufacturing.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.SpecialtyChemicals
member.summary: Companies that use base chemicals to produce value-added chemicals that are used in a variety of products. Includes companies that produce polishes, adhesives and sealants, explosives, printing ink, paint, carbon black, acids, repellants, and cleaning solutions.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.LumberAndWoodProduction
member.summary: Companies that grow timber, mill lumber, and manufacture wood and wood products for construction.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.PaperAndPaperProducts
member.summary: Companies that manufacture and market paper and paper-related products from wood pulp and other fibers. Excludes companies that produce paper packaging products and are classified in the packaging and containers industry.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.Aluminum
member.summary: Companies that produce, refine, market, and distribute aluminum and related aluminum-based products.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.Copper
member.summary: Companies engaged in the exploration, mining, smelting, and refining of copper ores and related copper products.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.OtherIndustrialMetalsAndMining
member.summary: Companies that mine, refine, produce, smelt, and mill industrial ores, including copper, lead, zinc, radium, vanadium, nickel, tin, titanium, and other related materials.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.Gold
member.summary: Companies principally engaged in gold exploration, mining, processing, extraction, and smelting.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.Silver
member.summary: Companies principally engaged in silver exploration, mining, processing, extraction, and smelting.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.OtherPreciousMetalsAndMining
member.summary: Companies that mine, refine, produce, smelt, and mill precious metals, including silver, platinum, palladium, diamond, and other related minerals.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.CokingCoal
member.summary: Companies that produce coking coal.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.Steel
member.summary: Companies that produce steel plates, steel sheets, bar and rod materials, structural steel, steel pipes and tubes, and stainless steel.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.AutoAndTruckDealerships
member.summary: Companies engaged in the specialty retail of new and used automobiles, trucks, and other vehicles through the operation and/or franchising of dealerships.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.AutoManufacturers
member.summary: Leading worldwide designers and manufacturers of passenger cars and trucks.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.AutoParts
member.summary: Companies that manufacture motor vehicle parts and accessories, including rubber and plastic products, such as tires and inner tubes, but do not manufacture complete car bodies.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.RecreationalVehicles
member.summary: Companies that manufacture recreational vehicles, including self-contained motor homes, campers, all-terrain vehicles, travel/camper trailers, and snowmobiles.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.Furnishings
member.summary: Companies that manufacture and market wooden, metal, and upholstered furniture, mattresses, bedsprings, lighting fixtures, wooden flooring, wallpaper, and household products, such as utensils, cutlery, tableware, and appliances.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.FixturesAndAppliances
member.summary: Companies that manufacture and market wooden, metal, and upholstered furniture, mattresses, bedsprings, lighting fixtures, wooden flooring, wallpaper, and household products, such as utensils, cutlery, tableware, and appliances.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.ResidentialConstruction
member.summary: Companies that build and renovate residential buildings, such as single-family houses, apartments, and hotels.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.TextileManufacturing
member.summary: Companies that manufacture and mill textile products, including apparel fabrics, bedding and accessories, home furnishing fabrics, carpets and rugs, curtains and drapes, and other milled textile products.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.ApparelManufacturing
member.summary: Companies that manufacture, design, market, source, and sell all lines of clothing for men, women, and children. Also includes companies that manufacture or distribute buttons, buckles, and other apparel parts.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.FootwearAndAccessories
member.summary: Companies that manufacture, design, market, and sell lines of footwear and luggage, handbags and purses, belts, and other leather goods.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.PackagingAndContainers
member.summary: Companies that manufacture and market paper, plastic, metal, and glass packaging products, including corrugated boxes, cardboard containers, bottles, cans, and plastic foam and containers.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.PersonalServices
member.summary: Companies that provide services of a personal nature or that are particularly structured for the individual or group being served, including veterinary services, funeral and cemetery services, child care services, portrait and photo services, tax preparation and legal services, and other miscellaneous personal services.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.Restaurants
member.summary: Companies that own, operate, and franchise full-service restaurants that engage in the retail sale of prepared food and drink.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.ApparelRetail
member.summary: Companies engaged in the retail sale of clothing, shoes, and accessories.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.DepartmentStores
member.summary: Companies engaged in the retail sale of a diverse mix of merchandise, emphasizing fashion apparel and accessories, home furnishings, electronics, and cosmetics.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.HomeImprovementRetail
member.summary: Companies engaged in the retail sale of home improvement items, such as lumber, carpets, hardware and other building materials, plants and other garden supplies, and various other items for the home.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.LuxuryGoods
member.summary: Companies engaged in the specialty retail of luxury items, including jewelry, watches, crystal, clothing, handbags, and accessories.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.InternetRetail

member.summary: Companies that own, operate, or manage lawful gaming activities and events, such as horse and dog racing, online gaming, bingo, and video lottery, as well as companies that supply products or services to gaming operators. It excludes companies operating casinos.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.Leisure
member.summary: Companies that manufacture, design, market, and sell bicycles, sporting goods, photographic equipment, recreational equipment, toys, and other leisure products or services.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.Lodging
member.summary: Companies that develop, manage, own, and operate lodging facilities, including motels, extended-stay and full-service hotels, and economy hotels and inns.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.ResortsAndCasinos

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.TravelServices

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.AssetManagement

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.BanksDiversified

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.BanksRegional

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.MortgageFinance
member.summary: Companies that originate, purchase, sell, and service home mortgage and equity loans.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.CapitalMarkets
member.summary: Large, major investment houses offering investment banking, merchant banking, underwriting, brokerage, research, advisory, and trading services to broad-based national and international markets.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.FinancialDataAndStockExchanges
member.summary: Companies that operate security exchanges, including companies that offer financial data such as ratings, investment research, and other research solutions.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.InsuranceLife

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.InsurancePropertyAndCasualty

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.InsuranceReinsurance

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.InsuranceSpecialty

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.InsuranceBrokers

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.InsuranceDiversified

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.ShellCompanies

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.FinancialConglomerates

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.CreditServices

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.RealEstateDevelopment

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.RealEstateServices

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.RealEstateDiversified

member.summary: Self-administered real estate investment trusts engaged in the development, acquisition, management, and disposition of lodging properties, including full- and limited-service hotels and motels.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.REITIndustrial
member.summary: Self-administered real estate investment trusts engaged in the development, acquisition, management, and disposition of industrial properties, including bulk warehouses, self-storage facilities, distribution facilities, and other light industrial facilities.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.REITOffice
member.summary: Self-administered real estate investment trusts engaged in the development, acquisition, management, and disposition of office properties, including office buildings, complexes, and centers.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.REITResidential
member.summary: Self-administered real estate investment trusts engaged in the development, acquisition, management, and disposition of residential properties, including apartments, multifamily and single-family mortgage loans, manufactured housing, mobile-home parks, and other residential properties.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.REITRetail
member.summary: Self-administered real estate investment trusts engaged in the development, acquisition, management, and disposition of retail properties, including community shopping centers, factory outlet shopping centers, enclosed shopping malls, strip centers, restaurants, and other retail properties.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.REITMortgage
member.summary: Self-administered real estate investment trusts engaged in the acquisition, management, and disposition of mortgage-backed securities. Also includes companies that provide financing for income-producing real estate by purchasing or originating mortgages and mortgage-backed securities; and earns income from the interest on these investments.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.REITSpecialty
member.summary: Self-administered real estate investment trusts engaged in the acquisition, management, and disposition of properties not classified elsewhere. Includes trusts that operate, lease, and invest in telecom towers, advertising spaces, timberland properties, and other properties not classified elsewhere.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.REITDiversified
member.summary: Self-administered real estate investment trusts engaged in the acquisition, management, and disposition of diversified property holdings, with no specific portfolio composition.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.BeveragesBrewers
member.summary: Companies that manufacture, sell, and distribute malt-based beverages, beers, and ales.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.BeveragesWineriesAndDistilleries
member.summary: Companies that manufacture, sell, and distribute distilled liquors and wine.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.BeveragesNonAlcoholic
member.summary: Companies that manufacture, sell, and distribute soft drinks, carbonated and spring water, fruit juices, and other nonalcoholic beverages.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.Confectioners
member.summary: Companies that manufacture and refine raw sugar, syrup or finished cane and beet sugar, candy and chewing gum, chocolate, and cocoa products.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.FarmProducts
member.summary: Companies that produce, raise, and grow agricultural and farm-based food products, including fruits, vegetables, other crop products, cattle, and eggs. Also includes seafood products.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.HouseholdAndPersonalProducts
member.summary: Companies that manufacture and market soaps and other detergents, polishing and sanitation goods and produce glycerin from vegetable and animal fats and oils. Also includes companies that manufacture and market personal-care products, including perfume, cosmetics, and other toilet preparations, infant and adult sanitary paper products, shaving razors and blades.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.PackagedFoods
member.summary: Companies that process and package food products, including frozen foods, grain products, canned foods, snack foods, health supplements, vitamins, and pet products.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.EducationAndTrainingServices
member.summary: Companies that provide educational and training services, including college and junior-college courses, higher-education programs, technical and vocational training, and other education services.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.DiscountStores
member.summary: Companies engaged in the retail sale of a variety of merchandise at low and discounted prices.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.FoodDistribution
member.summary: Companies primarily engaged in the distribution and supply of food products, including packaged goods, meat, dairy products, frozen foods, and related groceries to grocery stores, restaurants, and other food-service centers.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.GroceryStores
member.summary: Companies engaged in the retail sale of groceries, including dry goods, meat, produce, frozen foods, dairy products, seafood, deli/bakery, and nonfood items.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.Tobacco
member.summary: Companies that manufacture and market cigarettes, e-cigarettes, snuff, cigars, chewing tobacco, and all other tobacco products.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.Biotechnology
member.summary: Biotech and biopharmaceutical companies engaged in research, discovery, development, and production of innovative drug and drug-related technologies.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.DrugManufacturersGeneral
member.summary: Major, global pharmaceutical manufacturers offering a broad and diverse line of drug and healthcare products; industry leaders that have made a significant commitment to the research and development of a long pipeline of drugs.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.DrugManufacturersSpecialtyAndGeneric
member.summary: Companies engaged in development and discovery of branded forms of drug, drug-related products, generic drug products, and animal-related drugs. Also includes companies that cultivate, process, and farm cannabis or marijuana.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.HealthcarePlans
member.summary: Companies that offer a wide variety of managed health products and services, including HMOs, PPOs, and other health insurance plans, and are largely U.S.-domiciled.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.MedicalCareFacilities
member.summary: Companies that provide medical services through the ownership and operation of hospitals, and other auxiliary healthcare-related services, including healthcare staffing and ambulatory services. Also, companies that operate long-term-care facilities, such as assisted-living centers, nursing and retirement homes, substance-abuse centers, and centers for rehabilitation services.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.PharmaceuticalRetailers
member.summary: Companies engaged in the retail sale of prescription drugs and patent medicines as well as a number of related lines, such as cosmetics, toiletries, and novelty merchandise.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.HealthInformationServices
member.summary: Companies that develop and provide comprehensive physician practice management systems and software for hospitals, medical practices, and managed-care organizations.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.MedicalDevices
member.summary: Companies that develop, manufacture, and market medical and surgical equipment and machinery, including orthopedic products, respiratory care equipment, x-ray equipment, laser systems, implants, pacemakers, and other major medical machines and apparatus.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.MedicalInstrumentsAndSupplies
member.summary: Companies that develop, design, manufacture, and market medical and dental instruments and supplies, including wheelchairs, catheters, needles, syringes, eyewear and eyecare products, and other health-related supplies.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.DiagnosticsAndResearch
member.summary: Companies that provide laboratory testing services through imaging and other diagnostic services to the medical industry.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.MedicalDistribution
member.summary: Companies primarily engaged in the distribution and supply of medical instruments and supplies, ophthalmic goods, and other health-related items to the medical and healthcare industry.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.UtilitiesIndependentPowerProducers
member.summary: Companies that own and operate merchant power generation facilities and sell electricity into retail and wholesale markets.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.UtilitiesRenewable
member.summary: Companies that generate, produce, or transmit electric energy from renewable sources, including hydropower, wind, geothermal, biomass, solar, tidal, and wave.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.UtilitiesRegulatedWater
member.summary: Companies that distribute water for sale, including water-treatment companies.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.UtilitiesRegulatedElectric
member.summary: Companies that generate, transmit, or distribute electric energy for sale.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.UtilitiesRegulatedGas
member.summary: Companies that transmit, store, or distribute natural gas.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.UtilitiesDiversified
member.summary: Companies engaged in the regulated generation, transmission, or distribution of electricity and natural gas, merchant power generation facilities, and energy marketing operations.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.TelecomServices
member.summary: Companies that provide local, national, international, and long-distance phone services, as well as companies offering wireless services. Also includes companies that provide services for faxing, prepaid phone cards, pay phones, and directory assistance, or that provide Internet access services.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.AdvertisingAgencies
member.summary: Companies engaged in full-service advertising operations, including the planning, creating, producing, and placing of advertising in media such as TV, radio, and print. Also includes companies providing marketing services, including outdoor advertising, promotional materials, direct-mail services, digital marketing, event management services, and marketing research services.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.Publishing
member.summary: Companies that publish periodicals, such as magazines, comic books, trade journals, books, pamphlets, e-publications, and newspapers.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.Broadcasting
member.summary: Companies that own or operate radio broadcast stations and provide and produce radio programming services, television programming services, and television broadcast stations. Also includes companies providing Internet-based video on demand and pay-per-view programming services.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.Entertainment
member.summary: Companies primarily operating with diversified holdings in movies, television, and other media-based entertainment. Also includes companies that produce and distribute motion pictures, television programmers, video, and the operation of movie theaters; and provide cable television services.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.InternetContentAndInformation
member.summary: Companies that provide content, Internet navigation services, and reference guide information for the World Wide Web through its platforms, including social media, search engines, and networking platform companies.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.ElectronicGamingAndMultimedia
member.summary: Companies that primarily develop or publish video games and other multimedia software applications for devices that include personal computers, video game systems, cellphones, tablets, and other portable media players.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.OilAndGasDrilling
member.summary: Companies primarily engaged in the drilling for petroleum and natural gas.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.OilAndGasEAndP
member.summary: Energy companies which are primarily engaged in oil and gas exploration and production.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.OilAndGasIntegrated
member.summary: Major energy companies engaged in the diverse aspects of oil and gas operations, including crude oil and gas exploration, production, manufacturing, refining, marketing, and transportation.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.OilAndGasMidstream
member.summary: Companies that own and operate oilfield pipelines and are involved in the gathering, processing, and transportation of natural crude petroleum.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.OilAndGasRefiningAndMarketing
member.summary: Companies that refine, gather, market, and sell petroleum and petroleum products.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.OilAndGasEquipmentAndServices
member.summary: Companies that provide oilfield services and equipment for activities such as contract drilling and seismic surveys. Also includes equipment and tool rental, pumping and processing services, and inspection and contracting services.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.ThermalCoal
member.summary: Companies that mine thermal coal, which is used for generating energy. Excludes companies that mine coking coal to make steel.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.Uranium
member.summary: Companies that mine, refine, produce, and mill uranium and uranium-related materials.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.AerospaceAndDefense
member.summary: Companies that manufacture aerospace and defense products, including aircraft and aircraft parts, tanks, guided missiles, space vehicles, ships and marine equipment, and other aerospace and defense components and systems, as well as companies supporting these products through repair and maintenance services.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.SpecialtyBusinessServices
member.summary: Companies that provide services to the commercial or business market, including information distribution, warehousing, graphic design, accounting, printing, and miscellaneous services.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.ConsultingServices
member.summary: Companies that provide management, research, and consulting services to businesses and other agencies. Includes companies engaged in strategic and management consulting services, interior design, and information and analytics.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.RentalAndLeasingServices
member.summary: Companies that rent or lease durable goods to the commercial and consumer market, including cars and trucks, medical and industrial equipment, appliances and tools, and miscellaneous goods.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.SecurityAndProtectionServices
member.summary: Companies that provide security and protective services, including protective or preventive devices, security guards and inspection services, security alarm and monitoring systems, detention and correction facilities, and other security-based services.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.StaffingAndEmploymentServices
member.summary: Companies that provide staffing and employment services, including temporary staffing and permanent placement, outsources workforce and other employment-related services to businesses and government. Also includes companies providing online staffing services.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.Conglomerates
member.summary: Companies that are in several separate lines of business with no single line providing the dominant source of revenue or income.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.EngineeringAndConstruction
member.summary: Companies engaged in the design, construction, or contracting of industrial and nonresidential structures, streets and highways, bridges and tunnels, docks and piers, dams and water projects, utility lines, and other large building projects. Also includes companies that provide engineering consulting and architectural services to consumer and commercial clients.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.InfrastructureOperations
member.summary: Companies that develop, finance, maintain, or manage infrastructure operations such as ports, airports, and roadways.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.BuildingProductsAndEquipment
member.summary: Companies that manufacture building and construction products and materials, including ceramic floor and wall tiles, plumbing, HVAC, framing structures, and doors. Excludes companies that are classified in the building materials industry.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.FarmAndHeavyConstructionMachinery
member.summary: Companies that manufacture agricultural and construction machinery, including tractors, planting and harvesting machines, cranes, earthmovers, excavators, and related equipment and machinery. Includes truck manufacturers that provide local and long-haul trucking and transfer services for freight and cargo.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.IndustrialDistribution
member.summary: Companies primarily engaged in the distribution and supply of industrial equipment, including construction and farming machinery, garden equipment and supplies, and other industrial items to a diversified market of redistributors and end users.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.BusinessEquipmentAndSupplies
member.summary: Companies that manufacture and market office and business machines, such as copiers, fax machines, postage meters, point-of-sale terminals, and ATMs.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.SpecialtyIndustrialMachinery
member.summary: Companies engaged in diversified machinery manufacturing operations, including paper and food production machines, printing machinery, engines and turbines, air and gas processors, blowers and fans, furnaces and ovens, and other general and special industry machines.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.MetalFabrication
member.summary: Companies that fabricate, stamp, or form iron, steel, or other metals into products such as structured components by cutting, bending, and assembling processes of basic metals to create a final product.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.PollutionAndTreatmentControls
member.summary: Companies that manufacture equipment designed to control pollution, including control systems, hazardous waste disposal systems, recovery systems, treatment processes, filtration systems, cleaning and separation applications, and recycling machinery.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.ToolsAndAccessories
member.summary: Companies that manufacture small, hand-held tools, including power-driven drills, welding apparatus, lawn and garden equipment, and other power or manually operated tools and accessories, such as hardware, nuts, bolts, rivets, and other fasteners.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.ElectricalEquipmentAndParts
member.summary: Companies that manufacture electrical equipment (such as smart-grid electrical equipment, utility metering, high- and low-voltage electrical equipment, transmission control devices, switches, and lighting distribution boxes), batteries, electrical wires and cables, and automation control.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.AirportsAndAirServices
member.summary: Air transportation companies that provide related air services, including helicopter transportation, air-charter services, in-flight catering services, and air emergency and business-related services.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.Airlines
member.summary: Major international passenger airline companies that fly a wide range of domestic and international routes.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.Railroads
member.summary: Companies that provide transportation of freight by line-haul railroad as well as related railroad equipment and repair services. Includes companies offering passenger services via railway and roadways.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.MarineShipping
member.summary: Companies that transport freight and cargo via water and operate marine ports. Includes companies that provide passenger services via water.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.Trucking
member.summary: Companies that provide local and long-haul trucking and transfer services for freight and cargo.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.IntegratedFreightAndLogistics
member.summary: Companies that transport freight and cargo via diversified methods such as railroads, airlines, and waterways.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.WasteManagement
member.summary: Companies that collect, treat, store, transfer, recycle, and dispose of waste materials, as well as companies that provide supporting environmental, engineering, and consulting services.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.InformationTechnologyServices
member.summary: Companies that provide computer-system design, network and systems operations, repair services, technical support, computer technology consulting, development, and implementation services.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.SoftwareApplication
member.summary: Companies that primarily design, develop, market, and support application software programs, including those that are cloud-based, for specific consumer and business functions.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.SoftwareInfrastructure
member.summary: Companies that develop, design, support, and provide system software and services, including operating systems, networking software and devices, web portal services, cloud storage, and related services.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.CommunicationEquipment
member.summary: Companies that design, develop, manufacture, and market equipment for the communication industry, including fiber-optic cable; telecom peripherals; voice and data transmission and processing equipment; satellite products and equipment; video-conferencing systems and equipment; and interactive communication systems. Also includes companies that offer networking products that provide connectivity solutions for multi-use computing environments.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.ComputerHardware
member.summary: Companies that design, manufacture, and market computer systems, high mainframe servers, supercomputer, and 3D printers and scanners. Also includes companies that manufacture and market data storage products and other storage and backup devices for computers.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.ConsumerElectronics
member.summary: Companies that manufacture and market mobile communication products and household audio and video equipment, including radios, stereos, televisions, DVD player and personal use Drones. Excludes electric household appliances.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.ElectronicComponents
member.summary: Companies that design, develop, manufacture, and market electronic devices, including electron tubes; electronic capacitors; electronic resistors; electronic coil and transformers; sensors; LED, TFT, and LCD displays; electronic connectors; printed circuit boards; circuit assemblies; and other general-purpose electronics components and products.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.ElectronicsAndComputerDistribution
member.summary: Companies primarily engaged in the distribution, supply, and support of computers and computer systems, peripheral equipment, and software and other technological goods, including electronic equipment and appliances, electrical cable, wires, and other components to various consumer, commercial, and manufacturing customers.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.ScientificAndTechnicalInstruments
member.summary: Companies that design, develop, manufacture, and market sophisticated electronics of a technical nature, including lab apparatus, process and flow control devices, precise measurement and signal processing tools, search and navigation equipment, and other scientific or technical analytical or measuring devices.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.SemiconductorEquipmentAndMaterials
member.summary: Companies that design, develop, manufacture, and market equipment, spare parts, tools, cleaning devices, and related materials for the semiconductor industry.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.Semiconductors
member.summary: Semiconductor companies that design, manufacture, and market integrated circuits, microprocessors, logic devices, chipsets, and memory chips for a wide variety of users. Includes companies that design, manufacture, and market general-application integrated circuits and memory and memory-intensive products.

member.name: F:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.MorningstarIndustryCode.Solar
member.summary: Companies that design, manufacture, market, or install solar power systems and components.

member.name: T:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.AdditionalPaidInCapitalBalanceSheet
member.summary: Excess of issue price over par or stated value of the entity's capital stock and amounts received from other transactions involving the entity's stock or stockholders. Includes adjustments to additional paid in capital. There are two major categories of additional paid in capital: 1) Paid in capital in excess of par/stated value, which is the difference between the actual issue price of the shares and the shares' par/stated value. 2) Paid in capital from other transactions which includes treasury stock, retirement of stock, stock dividends recorded at market, lapse of stock purchase warrants, conversion of convertible bonds in excess of the par value of the stock, and any other additional capital from the company's own stock transactions.

member.name: T:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.AssetClassification
member.summary: Definition of the AssetClassification class

member.name: P:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.AssetClassification.StockType
member.summary: The purpose of the Stock Types is to group companies according to the underlying fundamentals of their business. They answer the question: If I buy this stock, what kind of company am I buying? Unlike the style box, the emphasis with the Stock Types is on income statement, balance sheet, and cash-flow data-not price data or valuation multiples. We focus on the company, not the stock. Morningstar calculates this figure in-house on a monthly basis.

member.name: P:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.AssetClassification.StyleBox
member.summary: The Morningstar Equity Style Box is a grid that provides a graphical representation of the investment style of stocks and portfolios. It classifies securities according to market capitalization (the vertical axis) and value-growth scores (the horizontal axis) and allows us to provide analysis on a 5-by-5 Style Box as well as providing the traditional style box assignment, which is the basis for the Morningstar Category. Two of the style categories, value and growth, are common to both stocks and portfolios. However, for stocks, the central column of the style box represents the core style (those stocks for which neither value nor growth characteristics dominate); for portfolios, it represents the blend style.

member.name: P:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.AssetClassification.GrowthGrade
member.summary: The growth grade is based on the trend in revenue per share using data from the past five years. For the purpose of calculating revenue per share we use the past five years' revenue figures and corresponding year-end fully diluted shares outstanding; if year- end fully diluted shares outstanding is not available, we calculate this figure by dividing the company's reported net income applicable to common shareholders by the reported fully diluted earnings per share. A company must have a minimum of four consecutive years of positive and non-zero revenue, including the latest fiscal year, to qualify for a grade. In calculating the revenue per share growth rate, we calculate the slope of the regression line of historical revenue per share. We then divide the slope of the regression line by the arithmetic average of historical revenue per share figures. The result of the regression is a normalized historical increase or decrease in the rate of growth for sales per share. We then calculate a z-score by subtracting the universe mean revenue growth from the company's revenue growth, and dividing by the standard deviation of the universe's growth rates. Stocks are sorted based on the z-score of their revenue per share growth rate calculated above, from the most negative z-score to the most positive z-score. Stocks are then ranked based on their z-score from 1 to the total number of qualified stocks. We assign grades based on this ranking. Stocks are assigned A, B, C, D, or F. Morningstar calculates this figure in-house on a monthly basis.

member.name: P:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.AssetClassification.FinancialHealthGrade
member.summary: Instead of using accounting-based ratios to formulate a measure to reflect the financial health of a firm, we use structural or contingent claim models. Structural models take advantage of both market information and accounting financial information. The firm's equity in such models is viewed as a call option on the value of the firm's assets. If the value of the assets is not sufficient to cover the firm's liabilities (the strike price), default is expected to occur, and the call option expires worthless and the firm is turned over to its creditors. To estimate a distance to default, the value of the firm's liabilities is obtained from the firm's latest balance sheet and incorporated into the model. We then rank the calculated distance to default and award 10% of the universe A's, 20% B's, 40% C's, 20% D's, and 10% F's. Morningstar calculates this figure in-house on a daily basis.

member.name: P:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.AssetClassification.ProfitabilityGrade
member.summary: The profitability grade for all qualified companies in Morningstar's stock universe is based on valuation of return on shareholders' equity (ROE) using data from the past five years. Morningstar's universe of stocks is first filtered for adequacy of historical ROE figures. Companies with less than four years of consecutive ROE figures including the ROE figure for the latest fiscal year are tossed from calculations and are assigned "--" for the profitability grade. For the remaining qualified universe of stocks the profitability grade is based on the valuation of the following three components, which are assigned different weights; the historical growth rate of ROE, the average level of historical ROE, the level of ROE in the latest fiscal year of the company. Stocks are assigned A, B, C, D, or F. Morningstar calculates this figure in-house on a monthly basis.

member.name: P:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.AssetClassification.MorningstarIndustryCode
member.summary: Equities are mapped into one of 148 industries, the one which most accurately reflects the underlying business of that company. This mapping is based on publicly available information about each company and uses annual reports, Form 10-Ks and Morningstar Equity Analyst input as its primary source. Other secondary sources of information may include company web sites, sell-side research (if available) and trade publications. By and large, equities are mapped into the industries that best reflect each company's largest source of revenue and income. If the company has more than three sources of revenue and income and there is no clear dominant revenue and income stream, the company is assigned to the Conglomerates industry. Based on Morningstar analyst research or other third party information, Morningstar may change industry assignments to more accurately reflect the changing businesses of companies.

member.name: P:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.AssetClassification.MorningstarIndustryGroupCode
member.summary: Industries are mapped into 69 industry groups based on their common operational characteristics. If a particular industry has unique operating characteristics-or simply lacks commonality with other industries-it would map into its own group. However, any industry group containing just one single industry does not necessarily imply that that industry is dominant or otherwise important. The assignment simply reflects the lack of a sufficient amount of shared traits among industries. See appendix for mappings.

member.name: P:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.AssetClassification.MorningstarSectorCode
member.summary: Industry groups are consolidated into 11 sectors. See appendix for mappings.

member.name: P:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.AssetClassification.MorningstarEconomySphereCode
member.summary: Sectors are consolidated into three major economic spheres or Super Sectors: Cyclical, Defensive and Sensitive. See appendix for mappings.

member.name: P:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.AssetClassification.SIC
member.summary: Standard Industrial Classification System (SIC) is a system for classifying a business according to economic activity. See separate reference document for a list of Sic Codes/Mappings.

member.name: P:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.AssetClassification.NAICS
member.summary: An acronym for North American Industry Classification System, it is a 6 digit numerical classification assigned to individual companies. Developed jointly by the U.S., Canada, and Mexico to provide new comparability in statistics about business activity across North America. It is intended to replace the U.S. Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system. See separate reference document for a list of NAICS Codes/Mappings.

member.name: P:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.AssetClassification.StyleScore
member.summary: The scores for a stock's value and growth characteristics determine its horizontal placement. The Value-Growth Score is a reflection of the aggregate expectations of market participants for the future growth and required rate of return for a stock. We infer these expectations from the relation between current market prices and future growth and cost of capital expectations under the assumption of rational market participants and a simple model of stock value.

member.name: P:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.AssetClassification.SizeScore
member.summary: Rather than a fixed number of large cap or small cap stocks, Morningstar uses a flexible system that isn't adversely affected by overall movements in the market. The Morningstar stock universe represents approximately 99% of the U.S. market for actively traded stocks. Giant-cap stocks are defined as the group that accounts for the top 40% of the capitalization of the Morningstar domestic stock universe; large-cap stocks represent the next 30%; mid-cap stocks represent the next 20%; small-cap stocks represent the next 7%; and micro-cap stocks represent the remaining 3%. Each stock is given a Size Score that ranges from -100 (very micro) to 400 (very giant). When classifying stocks to a Style Box, giant is included in large and micro is included in small.

member.name: P:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.AssetClassification.GrowthScore
member.summary: A high overall growth score indicates that a stock's per-share earnings, book value, revenues, and cash flow are expected to grow quickly relative to other stocks in the same scoring group. A weak growth orientation does not necessarily mean that a stock has a strong value orientation.

member.name: P:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.AssetClassification.ValueScore
member.summary: A high value score indicates that a stock's price is relatively low, given the anticipated per-sharing earnings, book value, revenues, cash flow, and dividends that the stock provides to investors. A high price relative to these measures indicates that a stock's value orientation is weak, but it does not necessarily mean that the stock is growth-oriented.

member.name: P:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.AssetClassification.NACE
member.summary: NACE is a European standard classification of economic activities maintained by Eurostat.

member.name: P:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.AssetClassification.CANNAICS
member.summary: Similar to NAICS (data point 3010, above), this is specifically for Canadian classifications. An acronym for North American Industry Classification System, it is a 6 digit numerical classification assigned to individual companies. Developed jointly by the U.S., Canada, and Mexico to provide new comparability in statistics about business activity across North America. It is intended to replace the U.S. Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system. See separate reference document for a list of NAICS Codes/Mappings. The initial SIC and NAICS listed is the Primary based on revenue generation; followed by Secondary SIC and NAICS when applicable. Both SIC and NAICS are manually collected and assigned.

member.summary: An expense recognized before it is paid for. Includes compensation, interest, pensions and all other miscellaneous accruals reported by the company. Expenses incurred during the accounting period, but not required to be paid until a later date.

member.name: P:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.BalanceSheet.NonCurrentAccruedExpenses
member.summary: An expense that has occurred but the transaction has not been entered in the accounting records. Accordingly, an adjusting entry is made to debit the appropriate expense account and to credit a liability account such as accrued expenses payable or accounts payable.

member.name: P:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.BalanceSheet.AccruedInvestmentIncome
member.summary: Interest, dividends, rents, ancillary and other revenues earned but not yet received by the entity on its investments.

member.name: P:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.BalanceSheet.AccumulatedDepreciation
member.summary: The cumulative amount of wear and tear or obsolescence charged against the fixed assets of a company.

member.name: P:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.BalanceSheet.GainsLossesNotAffectingRetainedEarnings
member.summary: The aggregate amount of gains or losses that are not part of retained earnings. It is also called other comprehensive income.

member.name: P:QuantConnect.Data.Fundamental.BalanceSheet.AdditionalPaidInCapital
member.summary: Excess of issue price over par or stated value of the entity's capital stock and amounts received from other transactions involving the entity's stock or stockholders. Includes adjustments to additional paid in capital.
